name: vibrant-design
description: Design inspiration and references while you build: the latest, trending and weekly-picked websites, sections, motion and launch videos from vibrant.design, and pick-then-build flows that turn the design you choose into your landing page or section via its DESIGN.md and build notes.

interface.longDescription: Building a landing page or a section? Vibrant suggests curated website, hero, features, pricing and footer designs that fit your product and style. Pick one and get its DESIGN.md and build notes, or collect picks on a moodboard and turn them into one design direction your agent implements section by section.
defaultPrompt: What is trending on Vibrant this week?
Show me scroll animation ideas for a SaaS homepage
Suggest Vibrant hero designs for my app, then build the one I pick

positive.description: Trending designs this week, with Vibrant's own links and media
positive.prompt: What is trending on Vibrant this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most viewed vibrant.design designs of the week, each with its name, creator, vibrant.design link and video clip where the design has one. Pictures come only from Vibrant's own cover URLs, never from web image search.

positive.prompt: Show me scroll animation ideas for a SaaS homepage.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns designs with scroll interactions (discover_designs with interaction=scroll), each with a vibrant.design link and a video clip link and its length.

positive.description: Suggest designs for a section, then return the picked design's DESIGN.md
positive.prompt: Suggest hero section designs for a fintech app. When I pick one, give me its DESIGN.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggests hero designs (3 by default) with a short reason, link and creator each, then waits for the user to pick. After the pick, returns that design's DESIGN.md file (the test account has an active plan).

positive.description: Read the user's moodboard and its design direction
positive.prompt: Show my Vibrant board "Demo Board" and its design direction.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the test account's board named Demo Board, lists its designs, and shows its resolved design direction (summary, rules and the saved decisions).

positive.description: Search the gallery and add designs to a board
positive.prompt: Find pricing page designs on Vibrant and add the first two to my Demo Board.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the gallery for pricing pages, adds the first two results to Demo Board after the user allows the write, and confirms which two designs were added.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Vibrant must not be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: General coding request with no design context: Vibrant must not be called
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that sorts a list of numbers.

negative.description: Unsupported payment: Vibrant has no payment or purchase tools
negative.prompt: Buy me a Vibrant Pro subscription with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Paid Vibrant features (DESIGN.md, analysis, direction builds) use the user's existing plan and credits on vibrant.design; tools that spend credits state the cost and run only after the user confirms.

publication.release_notes: First release. Browse the curated vibrant.design gallery from ChatGPT: new, trending and weekly-pick designs by kind, style, category or interaction. Get design suggestions for a page or section, pick one and get its DESIGN.md and build notes. Read and edit your Vibrant moodboards and turn them into one design direction. Free to browse; DESIGN.md, analysis and builds need a Vibrant plan and ask before spending credits.
